description: This file defines the MAX_Dal_Admin_Trackers class, which manages database interactions related to ad trackers, including retrieving linked campaigns and linking campaigns to trackers.

classes.name: MAX_Dal_Admin_Trackers
classes.description: A data access layer class for managing tracker records and their associations with campaigns in the database.

methods.name: getLinkedCampaigns
methods.description: Retrieves all campaigns linked to a specific tracker ID.

methods.name: linkCampaign
methods.description: Links a campaign to a tracker with an optional status.

methods.name: idExists
methods.description: Checks if a record exists in a specified table by ID.
